datasets.name: ds_overview_kpis
queryLines:
SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM gold_fleet_vehicle) AS fleet_size,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT vin) FROM gold_fleet_exposure) AS vehicles_exposed,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT campaign_number) FROM gold_fleet_exposure) AS open_campaigns,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT campaign_number) FROM gold_fleet_exposure WHERE park_it OR do_not_drive) AS urgent_campaigns

datasets.name: ds_fleet
queryLines: SELECT vin, make, model, model_year, segment, depot_id, gvwr_class, body_class, status, manufacture_date FROM gold_fleet_vehicle

datasets.name: ds_exposure
queryLines: SELECT vin, depot_id, campaign_number, component, make, model, segment, park_it, do_not_drive, match_basis, units_potentially_affected FROM gold_fleet_exposure

datasets.displayName: Campaigns ranked by consequence then volume
datasets.name: ds_top_campaigns
queryLines: SELECT campaign_number, MIN(component) AS component, BOOL_OR(park_it) AS park_it, BOOL_OR(do_not_drive) AS do_not_drive, COUNT(DISTINCT vin) AS vehicles, COUNT(DISTINCT depot_id) AS depots FROM gold_fleet_exposure GROUP BY campaign_number ORDER BY (park_it OR do_not_drive) DESC, vehicles DESC

datasets.name: ds_signals
queryLines: SELECT series_key, make, model, comp_top, run_start, run_end, run_len, max_z, complaints_in_run, harm_share, fleet_vehicles, is_live, as_of_month FROM gold_emerging_signal

datasets.name: ds_signals_kpis
queryLines:
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS total_signals,
  SUM(CASE WHEN is_live THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS live_signals,
  SUM(CASE WHEN fleet_vehicles > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fleet_signals
FROM gold_emerging_signal

columns.description: Total source rows ingested across all three entities
Rows routed to quarantine instead of silently dropped

datasets.name: ds_trust_recon
queryLines:
WITH recon AS (
  SELECT 'complaints (V+T scope)' AS entity,
         (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bronze_complaints WHERE PROD_TYPE IN ('V','T')) AS bronze_n,
         (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM silver_complaint) AS silver_n,
         (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM silver_complaint_quarantine) AS quarantine_n
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'recalls',
         (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bronze_recalls),
         (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM silver_recall),
         (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM silver_recall_quarantine)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'investigations',
         (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bronze_investigations),
         (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM silver_investigation),
         (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM silver_investigation_quarantine)
)
SELECT entity, bronze_n, silver_n, quarantine_n,
       CASE WHEN bronze_n = silver_n + quarantine_n THEN 'reconciled' ELSE 'MISMATCH' END AS reconciled
FROM recon

datasets.name: ds_trust_quarantine
queryLines:
SELECT 'complaints' AS entity, _dq_failures AS reason, COUNT(*) AS n FROM silver_complaint_quarantine GROUP BY 1,2
UNION ALL
SELECT 'recalls', _dq_failures, COUNT(*) FROM silver_recall_quarantine GROUP BY 1,2
UNION ALL
SELECT 'investigations', _dq_failures, COUNT(*) FROM silver_investigation_quarantine GROUP BY 1,2

datasets.name: ds_ops
queryLines: WITH wo AS (SELECT wo_id, service_campaign_id, vin, depot_id, assigned_to, due_date, status, actual_cost FROM (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY wo_id ORDER BY _sort_by DESC) AS rn FROM bootcamp_students.bootcamp_cdc.lb_fleetguard_work_order_history WHERE _pg_change_type <> 'update_preimage') WHERE rn = 1 AND _pg_change_type <> 'delete' ), sc AS (SELECT service_campaign_id, campaign_id FROM (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY service_campaign_id ORDER BY _sort_by DESC) AS rn FROM bootcamp_students.bootcamp_cdc.lb_fleetguard_service_campaign_history WHERE _pg_change_type <> 'update_preimage') WHERE rn = 1 AND _pg_change_type <> 'delete' ), rc AS (SELECT campaign_id, component, park_it FROM (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY campaign_id ORDER BY _sort_by DESC) AS rn FROM bootcamp_students.bootcamp_cdc.lb_fleetguard_recall_campaign_history WHERE _pg_change_type <> 'update_preimage') WHERE rn = 1 AND _pg_change_type <> 'delete' ) SELECT w.wo_id, w.status, w.vin, w.depot_id, w.assigned_to, w.due_date, COALESCE(w.actual_cost, 0) AS actual_cost, CASE WHEN w.actual_cost IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_costed, CASE WHEN w.status = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_completed, CASE WHEN w.status NOT IN ('COMPLETED','CANCELLED') AND w.due_date < current_date() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_overdue, d.region, d.city, d.depot_name, sc.campaign_id, SPLIT(rc.component, ':')[0] AS component, rc.component AS component_full, rc.park_it FROM wo w LEFT JOIN sc ON sc.service_campaign_id = w.service_campaign_id LEFT JOIN rc ON rc.campaign_id = sc.campaign_id LEFT JOIN gold_fleet_depot d ON d.depot_id = w.depot_id

datasets.name: ds_ops_audit
queryLines: SELECT audit_id, action, entity_type, entity_id, actor_principal, CAST(created_at AS DATE) AS audit_date FROM (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY audit_id ORDER BY _sort_by DESC) AS rn FROM bootcamp_students.bootcamp_cdc.lb_fleetguard_audit_log_history WHERE _pg_change_type <> 'update_preimage') WHERE rn = 1 AND _pg_change_type <> 'delete'

datasets.displayName: Agent writes joined to their trace and token cost
datasets.name: ds_ops_agent
queryLines: WITH usage AS (SELECT databricks_request_id, execution_duration_ms, status_code, SUBSTR(response, INSTR(response, 'mlflow.trace.tokenUsage'), 200) AS tu FROM fleetguard_agent_payload) SELECT a.action_id, a.tool, a.actor_principal, a.on_behalf_of, a.trace_id, u.execution_duration_ms, u.status_code, CAST(regexp_extract(u.tu, 'input_tokens[^0-9]+([0-9]+)', 1) AS INT) AS input_tokens, CAST(regexp_extract(u.tu, 'output_tokens[^0-9]+([0-9]+)', 1) AS INT) AS output_tokens, CAST(regexp_extract(u.tu, 'total_tokens[^0-9]+([0-9]+)', 1) AS INT) AS total_tokens, CASE WHEN a.trace_id IS NULL THEN 'not traced (pre E-03)' ELSE 'traced' END AS trace_state FROM gold_agent_action a LEFT JOIN usage u ON u.databricks_request_id = a.trace_id

lines: ## Signal detail, fleet-relevant first
# Does Early Warning Actually Work?
Measured against every ODI investigation opened since 2010, with a volume-matched placebo control arm. The gap between the arms is the evidence — the real arm alone is not.
## Real vs. placebo — from `evidence_metrics`, the governed metric view

**Stated limits.** It misses roughly five of every six investigations. The placebo control fires at double digits too, so most detections would have occurred on a busy series with no defect — this is an edge, not an oracle. It predicts that an **investigation will open**, not that a recall will be issued, and not which VINs are affected. Adding semantic clustering was tested and **made detection worse** (11.2%, zero extra lead time) — that negative result is published rather than buried.
# Trust — Does the Pipeline Do What It Claims?

Every layer reconciles exactly: **bronze = silver + quarantine**, with no silent drops. Rows that fail a quality check are routed to a quarantine table with a reason, never discarded. This page is the proof, not the claim.
## Reconciliation, by entity

lines: ## Why rows are quarantined
## Fleet-match confidence

**EXACT** matches NHTSA's make/model/year string exactly — the deterministic guarantee applies here. **MODEL_VARIANT** (the majority, ~3 in 4 rows) covers cases where NHTSA's model string differs from vPIC's (e.g. `F-250` vs `F-250 SD`) — still a real match, scored by Model B (83.7% precision / 96.3% recall), but not the same certainty as an exact string match. Only 91 of 163 fleet make/model/year combinations resolve as EXACT.
